gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP for FY2025-26 and Quarterly Estimates of GDP for Q4 (Jan–Mar) FY2025-26, released June 5, 2026. Q4 grew 7.8% YoY, flat versus Q3 FY26 (also 7.8%) and down from Q2 FY26 (8.4%); full-year FY26 provisional estimate at 7.7%. No newer quarterly release available — Q1 FY27 estimates are due Aug 31, 2026.

cpi.source: MoSPI Consumer Price Index Press Release for July 2026 (provisional, base year 2024): CPI YoY inflation at 4.45%, up from 4.38% in June 2026. Food inflation (CFPI) at 5.52% YoY.

gsec10y.source: Market reports (FX.co/Reuters citing CCIL benchmark 6.94% 2036 G-Sec) — 10Y yield closed at its highest level in over two months on Aug 20, 2026, extending an August rise toward an eight-week high after hawkish RBI Aug 3–5 MPC minutes (released Aug 19) lifted rate-hike expectations.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC held the repo rate at 5.25% on Aug 5, 2026 (fourth consecutive hold), maintaining a neutral stance. Governor Malhotra said the MPC is 'neither dovish nor hawkish' and wants greater clarity on the inflation outlook; Deputy Governor Gupta said there is no scope for further easing and flagged a possible case for a hike this fiscal year. Not in an easing cycle; policy risk has shifted toward tightening.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution, August 3–5, 2026 (via Business Standard, Forbes India MPC coverage); Aug 19, 2026 MPC minutes.

gov_capex.note: CPSE capex rose 26% YoY to ₹2.10 lakh crore in Q1 FY27 (Apr–Jun 2026), reaching 25% of the full-year target versus 22% achieved in the same period of FY26. FY27 Union Budget capex target remains ₹12.2 lakh crore (+9% YoY). Capex-led growth push continues into FY27, though state-level capex utilisation eased in Q1FY27.
gov_capex.source: CPSE capital expenditure data reported via Business Standard ('CPSEs meet 25% of FY27 cumulative capital expenditure target in Q1', 'State capex utilisation eases in Q1FY27'), July 2026.

china_plus_one.note: India's Cabinet eased FDI rules in March 2026 to allow non-controlling Chinese stakes of up to 10% without prior approval, plus a 60-day fast-track approval for priority manufacturing (electronics, capital goods, solar). FY26 FDI inflows grew 18% YoY to USD 58.85 bn. Early-August 2026 commentary confirms India continues to balance courting China-linked manufacturing investment with trade/anti-dumping caution — the China+1 diversification thesis remains active.
china_plus_one.source: Commerce Ministry FDI policy (Press Note 3 relaxation, Mar 2026); EcoNiti Daily Brief 'India dilutes FDI curbs on China, softens anti-dumping stance to court trade', Aug 2, 2026.

rural_recovery.note: IMD forecasts below-normal rainfall (<94% of LPA) for Aug–Sep 2026 amid El Niño; kharif sowing trailed ~3% YoY as of end-July 2026 (pulses and coarse cereals down 6–8% YoY), though narrower than the ~23% YoY gap seen in late June. A NABARD survey signals a rural slowdown, with income growth at a two-year low and rising informal borrowing; major reservoirs at ~44% of capacity.
rural_recovery.source: IMD Southwest Monsoon updates and ICRA 'Mid-Monsoon Update — August 2026'; USDA FAS 'Monsoon Recovery Fails to Boost Sluggish Crop Planting' (Aug 2026); NABARD rural sentiment survey.

put_call_ratio.source: NSE Nifty option-chain aggregate PCR via NiftyTrader.in, as of Aug 21, 2026 (Total Put OI 29.67 vs Total Call OI 27.39, in lakhs); cross-checked against other aggregators showing ~1.0–1.1 range same day.
